capabilities: Set a list's numbering style inline via the first item
Choose any CSS list-style-type by full name, such as upper-alpha
Use shorthand codes for common styles ({A}, {a}, {I}, {i}, {01}, {1})
extras: Documents gotchas, e.g. on mobile sub-lists may inherit the parent list's style and must be set back manually; style cannot be changed mid-list.
problem: Obsidian ordered lists only render with one default numbering style, so users wanting letters, Roman numerals, or zero-padded numbers have no built-in way to switch per list.
summary: Inline ordered-list styling that lets you set a list's numbering style (alphabetic, Roman numerals, leading zeros) via a bracketed code in the first item.
